payout_quote: You'll earn a bonus stock reward each time you reach a qualifying referral milestone. You can earn up to $15,000 in bonus stock rewards per year. | Qualifying Referrals: 1 referral -> $50 ... You can sell your stock reward 3 trading days after it's granted. ... To withdraw the proceeds, you must keep the cash value of the stock reward in your account for at least 60 days after claiming it.
timing: Milestone reward credited within ~1 week after claiming; must claim within 60 days; stock sellable after 3 trading days; cash withdrawable after 60 days
eligibility: US residents only; referrer needs an active Robinhood individual brokerage account in good standing; each referred friend must open a Robinhood individual taxable brokerage account, link bank/debit card, and fund it with a settled deposit greater than $0; referrals counted from Sep 1, 2026
steps: Open/fund your own Robinhood brokerage account
Share your Robinhood referral link with a friend
Friend opens a Robinhood account, links a bank, and funds it with a settled deposit
Claim your $50 milestone reward in Rewards within 60 days
Sell after 3 trading days; withdraw cash after 60 days
catches: A signup alone does nothing - your friend must FUND the account with a settled deposit, or the referral doesn't count.
Milestones only: referral #2 alone earns nothing; you get paid at 1 ($50), 3 ($150), 10 ($800), 50 ($4,000), 200 ($10,000).
The reward is STOCK (whole/fractional shares from a fixed list), not cash - you must wait 3 trading days to sell and 60 days to withdraw the proceeds.
Stock can fall in value between grant and sale; the $50 is a grant-date value.
Referral rewards are taxable and may be reported on Form 1099.
US residents only; Washington state texting restriction.
biggest_catch: Your friend must actually fund a brokerage account for you to get anything - and the $50 arrives as stock you can't sell for 3 trading days or withdraw as cash for 60 days.

maximize: Milestones pay in jumps, so batch your referrals: the 3rd funded friend unlocks $150 total, meaning referral #2 and #3 together are worth $100. Line up 3 friends and walk them all through funding in the same week. Every friend must make a SETTLED deposit - a signup alone earns nothing - and you must claim each reward within 60 days or it vanishes.
